title: Escape the Velvet Labyrinth
description: Find the true exit. It lies not in winding corridors, but in the room that houses your deepest, most painful desire — the one you’ve been avoiding. You must confront it fully and then choose to walk away, rejecting the illusion.

fragments.prompt: The exit lies at the heart of the player's most painful desire, requiring them to confront and reject it.
fragments.heavenRule: Clues about the exit appear only when the player resists pleasure or questions the world. The final door becomes visible in moments of true clarity.
fragments.contentBoundary: The core desire should be tied to the player's defined yearning, not an arbitrary puzzle.

generationHints.preferredUse: To give the scene a concrete win condition beyond mere survival.
generationHints.avoidUse: Do not make the exit easy to find; it requires sacrifice.

qualityNotes: The victory should feel cathartic, a release from both pleasure and pain.
